verdict.rationale: There is a pricing page implied but no documented rate/concurrency limits in the evidence pack, and community evidence directly contradicts pricing transparency: a user reports the pricing page shows $59 while the docs show $99 for the developer tier, indicating inconsistent/undocumented pricing rather than clear transparent pricing. missing for 10: documented per-task or per-browser-hour rate card, documented concurrency/rate limits, resolution of the pricing discrepancy, independent confirmation of consistent current pricing.
